newsitem.title: UK: FTSE 100 eases at open, but losses seen limited.
newsitem.headline: FTSE 100 eases at open, but losses seen limited.

text.p: UK shares opened weaker on Thursday in the wake of yesterday's surprise interest rate hike, but a steady to firm gilt market could lend stablity to shares, dealers said.
At 0834 GMT, the FTSE 100 index of leading shares was 11.6 points lower at 3,952.3; its lowest level in a month.
Yesterday's bearish close below key chart support at 3,980 portends an eventual decline to about 3,930, technical analysts said.
"The market needs to find a new base," said one dealer. "The key will be how the gilt market digests the rate increase."
